title: 第十章 顺利
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
季南北的询问来得有些出人意料，至少对萧京溪而言是如此。

    但略微一怔后，萧京溪还是给出了回答:

    “会的。虽然法术可以保持日常洁净，但偶尔还是会去日月泉。”

    “日月泉?”

    “嗯，日月泉。在侧厢房里，那儿和这儿一样，也是一处独立的小空间，里面有眼泉水，灵气浓郁，泉水都带着几分灵液的效果。”

    季南北再次真切体会到，萧京溪这位身家丰厚的姑娘，究竟有多么富裕。

    那可是灵泉啊!

    萧京溪不仅独占一处，平日里还能用来沐浴!

    修仙界也有万恶的资本家啊!

    季南北心里直泛酸!

    于是带着点小小的“报复”心理，打算逗逗这姑娘。

    “那去泡一会儿吧!“

    季南北故意这么提议。

    “好呀好呀!”

    季南北:???

    没承想，萧京溪不仅一口答应，还显得挺雀跃。

    这丫头的脑回路绝对异于常人!

    “怎么?小剑仙已经大方到能在男子面前袒露无碍啦?”

    此言一出，季南北立刻感觉到从萧京溪那边传来的惊愕情绪，以及相当程度的羞赧。嗯，这才是正常反应嘛!

    “你......你是男子!?“

    萧京溪的声音有些发颤。

    季南北马上反应过来。

    萧京溪根本无从知晓他的性别信息，他与对方交流时，用的始终是萧京溪的身体，发出的也是萧京溪的声音。

    啧，为了逗这姑娘，好像不经意泄露了点自己的底细。

    总觉得有点亏啊。

    不过，既然已经说漏了，季南北也就没再多此一举地遮掩，而是坦率道:

    “对啊，我是男的哦，现在知道怕了吧?”

    “那个......沐浴的事，可以让我自己来吗?”

    萧京溪的语气里透着明显的羞怯。“那怎么行呢?还是让我来帮你吧!”

    季南北一下子从草地上站了起来。
content_en:
Ji Nanbei's inquiry came somewhat unexpectedly, at least to Xiao Jingxi.

    But after being slightly startled, Xiao Jingxi still answered:

    "Yes. Although the spell can keep me clean every day, I still go to Sun Moon Spring occasionally."

    "Sun Moon Spring?"

    "Yes, the Sun and Moon Spring. In the side room, it is a small independent space just like here. There is a spring in it. The spiritual energy is rich, and the spring water has some spiritual liquid effects."

    Ji Nanbei once again realized how wealthy Xiao Jingxi, a wealthy girl, was.

    That is a spiritual spring!

    Xiaojing Creek not only occupies its own place, it can also be used for bathing on weekdays!

    There are also evil capitalists in the world of immortality!

    Ji Nanbei felt sour in his heart!

    So with a little "revenge" mentality, I planned to tease this girl.

    "Then go take a dip for a while!"

    Ji Nanbei suggested this deliberately.

    "Okay, okay!"

    Ji Nanbei:???

    Unexpectedly, Xiao Jingxi not only agreed, but also seemed very excited.

    This girl's brain circuit is definitely different from ordinary people!

    "What? The little sword fairy is already generous enough to show off in front of men without any hindrance?"

    As soon as these words came out, Ji Nanbei immediately felt the consternation coming from Xiao Jingxi, as well as a considerable degree of shame. Well, this is a normal reaction!

    "You...you are a man!?"

    Xiao Jingxi's voice was trembling.

    Ji Nanbei reacted immediately.

    Xiao Jingxi had no way of knowing his gender information. When he communicated with the other party, he always used Xiao Jingxi's body and made Xiao Jingxi's voice.

    Gee, in order to tease this girl, it seems that I accidentally revealed some of my own details.

    I always feel a bit at a loss.

    However, since it had been revealed, Ji Nanbei did not bother to cover it up, but said frankly:

    "Yes, I'm a man. Now you know you're afraid, right?"

    "Um...can I do the bathing by myself?"

    There was obvious shyness in Xiao Jingxi's tone. "Then what should we do? Let me help you!"

    Ji Nanbei suddenly stood up from the grass.
